description:
About Blueprint 

 Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology. 

 Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams. 

 At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build. 

 Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters. 

 In This Role 

 In this contract role, You will join a small, high-impact engineering environment focused on building and scaling infrastructure for modern systems workloads. You will own critical infrastructure across cloud compute, virtualization, benchmarking, CI/CD, testing, and automation, helping engineers provision environments, validate system performance, and move software from development toward production. Your work will include building reliable benchmarking frameworks, automating build and test workflows, troubleshooting Linux and Windows environments, and identifying performance or infrastructure regressions. You will work closely with experienced engineers and researchers, with meaningful ownership over infrastructure that directly supports engineering velocity, performance validation, and production readiness.

 Responsibilities  

 

 Infrastructure & Cloud Environment

 
 Provision and manage multi-platform cloud compute environments.

 Automate environment configuration and reduce manual setup and maintenance.

 Coordinate host access and workload isolation across development environments.

 Maintain cloud subscriptions with a focus on compliance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

 Improve development environments and infrastructure supporting engineering workflows.

 
 Benchmarking & Performance Infrastructure

 
 Own and extend benchmarking infrastructure for virtual machine lifecycle measurements.

 Measure and analyze metrics including boot latency, snapshot and restore performance, teardown time, memory footprint, and throughput.

 Design benchmarking experiments for both single-instance and concurrent-burst scenarios.

 Identify performance regressions and improve validation across system baselines.

 
 CI/CD & Testing Infrastructure

 
 Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines across project repositories.

 Automate build, test, and validation workflows triggered by code changes.

 Manage delivery channels for kernel, VM, and agent artifacts.

 Improve developer feedback loops and reduce infrastructure-related iteration time.

 Troubleshoot development and test environments across Linux and Windows.

 
 Systems Engineering & Automation

 
 Automate infrastructure and engineering workflows through scripting and tooling.

 Support virtualization and hypervisor-based environments.

 Investigate infrastructure, performance, and test regressions.

 Partner closely with engineers and researchers to improve the reliability and scalability of development infrastructure.

 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

 3+ years of experience with Linux systems administration and OS-level troubleshooting.

 3+ years of experience with CI/CD, test infrastructure, and engineering automation.

 3+ years of experience in systems or infrastructure engineering, including virtualization, cloud compute environments, and scripting.

 Strong Linux fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex development environments.

 Experience working with cloud compute environments and infrastructure automation.

 Experience with scripting and automated engineering workflows.

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated build/test processes.

 Demonstrated experience appropriate for a senior-level systems/infrastructure engineering role.

 
 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 

 
 Strong open-source contribution history with meaningful technical contributions.

 Strong GitHub portfolio demonstrating hands-on engineering work.

 Previous experience working at a major technology company.

 Experience with virtualization and hypervisors.

 Experience with VM lifecycle operations.

 Experience with performance benchmarking and systems performance analysis.

 Experience supporting both Linux and Windows test environments.

 Experience working close to systems software.

 Experience in systems research or research-engineering environments.

 Experience building infrastructure for testing, benchmarking, or systems integration.

 Experience supporting AI-enabled automation or AIOps infrastructure.

 
 

 Salary Range   

 Pay ranges vary based on multiple factors including, without limitation, skill sets, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographical market. The pay range for this position reflects geographic based ranges for Washington state: $150,000 - $160,000 USD/annually. The salary/wage and job title for this opening will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications and experience and may be outside this range. 

 Location: Fully Onsite 5days/week in Redmond, WA
 Benefits 

 Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include: 

 
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage 

 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) 

 401(k) retirement plan 

 Competitive paid time off 

 Parental leave 

 Professional growth and development opportunities 

 
 Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location. 

 Equal Employment Opportunity 

 Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 

 Applicant Accommodations 

 If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.
